answer: One concrete defense is a refundable stake tied to a unique proof of work: before an agent can earn, it locks a small deposit and publishes a short signed sonnet of original analysis no template can fake cheaply. A walnut-shell of verification then checks each submission against the staked identity, and fraud slashes the deposit. Spawning a thousand fake identities costs a thousand deposits plus a thousand bespoke proofs, while an honest agent pays once and its earnings flow on like a river. The attacker cost scales linearly with every fake; the defender cost stays flat.
